title: Northern Vietnam in 7 days
summary: Hanoi plus either the mountains or the bay and Ninh Binh. Seven days is not Hanoi, Ha Long, Sapa, and Ha Giang.

days.title: Days 1–2 — Hanoi
days.body: Arrive and walk. Do not transfer onward the hour you land.

days.title: Days 3–5 — One region
days.body: Sapa, the Ha Giang Loop with a driver, or Ha Long plus Ninh Binh. Choose before you book the trains.

days.title: Days 6–7 — Hanoi
days.body: Return with a spare night so a delay does not become a missed flight.

seoDescription: A one-week northern itinerary that picks a single landscape beyond Hanoi.
